text:
mira: alert from tenant: 'atlas-pay' - mass SCIM 429s and SAML logins failing with signature errors since our RBAC expansion rollout. any quick ideas?
dev: grabbing logs. identity-provisioner shows: 
```
2026-03-25T08:10:02Z identity-provisioner ERROR kms: decrypt failed: NotFound
2026-03-25T08:10:03Z scim PATCH 429 tenant=atlas-pay body_len=4012 id=usr_aa...
2026-03-25T08:10:04Z auth-gateway WARN saml: assertion_len=4520 groups=460
```
samir: likely same pattern - RBAC flatten increased group attrs -> assertion/header grew -> some gateways truncate signature header -> 403/invalid-signature. NotFound on KMS implies rotation + re-encrypt backlog.
mira: immediate mitigations: 1) pause SCIM retries for atlas-pay 2) bump re-encrypt backfill priority 3) temporary cap assertion length on auth-gateway to avoid silent truncation.
dev: pausing retries now. ops-bot: action executed: scim.retry.pause tenant=atlas-pay
samir: promoting backfill, adding alias-history fallback in decrypt path (if NotFound then try previous aliases). will open hotfix PR.
mira: I'll notify support and the customer. keep me posted on metrics.
dev: after backfill QPS bump, KMS NotFound errors fell ~90% in 8 minutes, SCIM 429s reduced. auth-gateway cap added to canary.
samir: opening PR: `provisioner: alias-history fallback` and will add unit tests for alias lookup behavior.
mira: good work. postmortem notes to include: sequencing rotations with re-encrypt, assertion size guardrails, and KMS propagation checks in rotation playbook.
